question: Can unchanged native contract/clock/pedal sources cross-compile as strict binary64 Cortex-M4 objects, and what object sections, local stack records, ABI tags and undefined dependencies result?
scope: Object-only compile and metadata inspection; no link, execution, firmware, MCU access or runtime semantic changes

hardware_context.FPU: ST documents single-precision FPv4-SP; double arithmetic may require software helpers

source_identity_policy: Require LF-normalized source equality to frozen PR71 bytes; record and snapshot exact execution bytes. No native C/H changes.

toolchain.name: Arm Toolchain for Embedded
toolchain.portable_location: workspace work/tools only; never globally installed
toolchain.verification: Before execution verify published archive size/SHA, extract only safe contained entries into a new directory and retain per-file hashes/licenses; verify compiler/tools against original ZIP entries.
toolchain.GNU_preference_attempt: Official GNU installation guide read by ordinary HTTPS; official downloads page returned Access Denied. Earlier owner attempt encountered GitLab bot control. No bypass or guessed asset links; use this official fallback.
toolchain.license: Retain package licenses/notices and provenance; component licenses vary. No toolchain redistribution or binaries committed.

working_directory: exact six-file native source snapshot; input units passed by relative filename
stack_evidence: Clang's documented -fstack-usage emits .su local function stack records where supported; retain exact output and qualifier. Not GCC-generated data. Not a call-chain/ISR/RTOS/helper-inclusive bound.
verification: Reject existing output, source/header aliases, unexpected source changes, unverified tools, unknown ABI/flags and link/flash commands.
Compile all twelve objects under the same frozen matrix; retain failures rather than adjusting source or math policy.
Check ELF32 ARM relocatable, ARMv7E-M/M-profile/Thumb attributes, actual hard versus base/softfp VFP argument tags (omitted default tag is reported as such).
Retain strict binary64 compile guards and flag diagnostics; no Omax/Osize/fast-math configs, no float substitution.
Retain object text/data/bss and full section table, undefined arithmetic/libc/helper references and every emitted per-function stack record.
Compare repeated object hashes for each of six ABI/unit pairs; label exact conditions rather than claiming all-host reproducibility.
Build harness tests exercise create-only/identity/path/flag/metadata guards using fake tools; actual successful builds remain separate evidence.
Independent practical source and artifact review before draft PR; retain full original attempts and local receipts.
stop_rules: No compiler invocation before root reviews this protocol and proposed commands
Checksum/size mismatch or unsafe archive entry stops before any extracted executable is run
Compiler/header/flag failure is a retained feasibility result; any necessary protocol amendment is separately versioned before further builds
limitations: Unknown exact MCU part, board configuration, team toolchain, ABI, startup and library versions
Unresolved symbols are not linked library size or helper runtime behavior
Object section sums are not full-firmware flash/RAM fit; no guessed memory limits
Per-function local stack data excludes called helpers, caller frames, interrupt/FPU context and scheduling
No measured target parity, timing, deadline, WCET, CAN/vehicle behavior or safety approval
Ordinary local checkout work; no Company Runtime task/run/acceptance identity is fabricated

primary_sources.support: STM32F405/407 DS8626 Rev12, section2/3.1: Cortex-M4 and single-precision FPU; no exact-part budget selected
AN4044 Rev2 section3/Table6: Cortex-M4 FPv4-SP only
Official portable extraction, target/FPU multilib selection, package licenses; Omax enables fast-math and is excluded
Clang float-ABI, contraction, freestanding, default-config and stack-usage flags; installed22.1.0 diagnostics are retained
Berkeley text/data/bss versus SysV section accounting
Tag_ABI_VFP_args=0 base/1 VFP convention; no presumed team ABI
